newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht recovers after intervention, statement.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht recovers after intervention, statement.

text.p: The Thai baht rose sharply in late trade on Monday after dropping to a record low in morning trade after the central bank intervened and said the baht had already fallen to a very low level, dealers said.
"The baht significantly improved in the afternoon. The central bank's intervention and its statement helped boost confidence (in the currency)," said one foreign bank dealer.

The baht was quoted at 29.00/30.00 near the close in the domestic market compared with 30.30/30.75 early. The baht fell to 30.80 early, prompting the Bank of Thailand to intervene by selling dollars around 30.75/30.80, dealers said.
